ui_usage_cost_note: Mutengo ufungidziro: izvo matokeni aya angadai akabhadharwa kuburikidza neAPI yemupi pamitengo yakanyorwa. Hazvisi izvo zvaunobhadhara; kunyoresa hakubhadhariswe pachikumbiro chimwe nechimwe.
ui_idle_hint: Dzvanya aikoni yeekisitenshoni kuti upfupise peji rino.
ui_truncated: Peji iri raive refu; chikamu chekutanga chete ndicho chakapfupiswa.
error_page_unreadable: Peji iri harigone kuverengwa. Mapeji ebhurauza neChrome Web Store hazvitsigirwe.
error_no_content: Hapana mavara echinyorwa akawanikwa papeji rino.
error_needs_click: Dzvanya aikoni yeekisitenshoni kuti upfupise peji rino. Mushure mekunge tebhu yaenda kune rimwe peji, ekisitenshoni inoda kudzvanywa patsva kuti iriverenge.
error_host_missing: Chikamu chemuno hachina kuiswa kana kuti hachisi kupindura. Mufolda yeekisitenshoni, mhanyisa: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: Claude Code haina kuwanikwa. Iise, wozomhanyisa ./native-host/install.sh zvakare.
error_claude_auth: Claude Code haina kupinda muakaundi. Mhanyisa claude mutheminari wopinda.
error_codex_signed_out: Codex haina kupinda muakaundi. Mhanyisa codex login mutheminari.
error_codex_not_eligible: Purani yako yeChatGPT haigone kushandiswa pane izvi. Sarudza mumwe mupi.
error_usage_limit: Wasvika pamuganhu wekushandisa wepurani yako. Edza zvakare gare gare kana kusarudza mumwe mupi.
error_provider_failed: Mupi akundikana achinyora chidimbu. Edza zvakare.
error_codex_missing: Codex haina kuwanikwa. Iise, wozomhanyisa ./native-host/install.sh zvakare.
options_help: Zvidimbu zvinopfuura nechikamu chemuno pakombiyuta ino: chinomhanyisa Claude Code kana Codex uchishandisa kunyoresa kwako, kana modhi iri mu Ollama. Mavara epeji anotumirwa chete kumupi waunosarudza.
error_ollama_missing: Ollama haisi kushanda pakombiyuta ino. Iise kubva ku ollama.com woivhura, wozoedza zvakare.
error_ollama_model_missing: Modhi iyi haina kudhawunirodhwa mu Ollama. Mhanyisa ollama pull nezita remodhi (semuenzaniso, ollama pull llama3.2), wozoedza zvakare.
options_models_auto: Zvinobva kuClaude Code, Codex neOllama, uye zvinoverengwazve kamwe pazuva, kana Claude Code kana Codex yagadziridzwa, uye kana ekisitenshoni yagadziridzwa.
error_file_access: Kuti upfupise mafaira ari pakombiyuta ino, vhura Ruzivo rweekisitenshoni pa chrome://extensions ubva wabatidza Bvumira kuwana maURL emafaira.
error_pdf_unreadable: PDF iyi haigone kuvhurwa. Inogona kunge yakachengetedzwa nepasiwedhi kana kuti yakakuvara.
error_pdf_no_text: PDF iyi haina mavara ekupfupisa. Inogona kunge yakagadzirwa nemifananidzo yakaskenwa.
history_empty: Hapana zvidimbu parizvino. Zvinoonekwa pano paunozviita.
error_no_transcript: Vhidhiyo iyi haina zvinyorwa zvemashoko ekupfupisa. YouTube inenge iine zvinyorwa izvi chete kana vhidhiyo iine mazwi ari pasi kana mazwi ari pasi ekuzviitira.
options_styles_help: Chimiro chinowedzera murayiro kuchidimbu, semuenzaniso: Chipfupise sezvinyorwa zvipfupi zvitatu zvakateedzana.
